 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. LaMelo Ball and the Minnesota Timberwolves host Jalen Brunson and the reigning NBA champion New York Knicks on Thursday during the 2026-27 NBA regular season.
 New York enters the game with an 8-6 record, sitting in third place in the Atlantic Division of the Eastern Conference. The Knicks enter the game on a two-game winning streak, having most recently defeated the Toronto Raptors 111-102 on Tuesday.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Guard Brunson, who leads the team in scoring at 27.0 points per game, scored a game-high 31 points. Center Karl-Anthony Towns, who leads the league in rebounding at 14.1 rebounds per game, secured 16 rebounds in the matchup while also dishing out a game-high eight assists.
 Knicks vs Timberwolves TV Channels and Live Stream Options
 New York Knicks center Karl-Anthony Towns (32) talks with point guard Jalen Brunson (11).Vincent Carchietta-Imagn Images
 Time: 8 p.m. ET
 Venue: Target Center, Minneapolis
 TV: DirecTV, NBA TV, DAZN MIN
 Live stream: YouTube TV, Sling TV, Fubo
 Fans can watch for free most readily through the Fubo app. Another way for fans to watch for free is through DirecTV. Users can subscribe to DirecTV with a free trial that can be canceled within five days. Fans can also watch for free through YouTube TV, where users can sign up for a free trial that can be canceled within 10 days.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Minnesota enters the game on a two-game winning streak, most recently defeating the Portland Trail Blazers in back-to-back games on Monday and Tuesday. Guard Ayo Dosunmu leads the team in scoring at 18.6 points per game. Center Rudy Gobert leads the team in rebounding at 11.1 rebounds per game, while guard Ball leads the team with 5.5 assists per game.
 For Minnesota, forward Jonathan Kuminga is a game-time decision with a shoulder injury, while guard Jaylen Clark (hamstring), star guard Anthony Edwards (knee) and guard Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles) will miss the game.
